crosswalk.note: Capability growth is the model layer's product; inference price at fixed capability ⇄ price-per-token pass-through; open-weights lag ⇄ open-vs-closed gap.

definition: Annualised revenue run-rates for OpenAI and Anthropic as compiled by Epoch AI from press reports; each point is an annualised month, not booked revenue.

direction_rule.rationale: Four reports; moves under $2B are reporting noise. Rising run-rate concentrates revenue at the two frontier labs.

status_events.author: evaluate
status_events.reason: Evaluator: 4e+10 (Epoch AI data hub — AI companies, 2026-08-13) reads concentrating over 4 periods with a dead band of 2e+09. Auto-reason; rule rationale: Four reports; moves under $2B are reporting noise. Rising run-rate concentrates revenue at the two frontier labs.

timing_rationale: Coincident: an annualised month of revenue moves with current usage and pricing and is reported within weeks.
tracker_interpretation: Run-rates are compounding at rates no software company has printed, but every point is a leak to a journalist and definitions drift between gross and net.
why_it_matters: Whether the model layer keeps surplus depends on revenue growing faster than the capital it consumes. Run-rate is the only public series, and it is press-sourced.
